definition: ExistingInActAt m InAct esse w says that every x with m.ExistsAt w x satisfies the supplied InAct x esse predicate. It is one direction at one selected world, not an equivalence or a theory of all perfections. It imposes no presence condition on a merely alleged cause and supplies no causal, explanatory, modal or essence–esse identity conclusion.
note: An OPEN semantic interface between the existing Ontic assignment and a supplied act-in-esse reading, introduced for the direct q3a4 integration in #319. Its applicability to a specific interpretation must be defended independently; the Lean declaration does not assert it. No source attribution is claimed. The linked candidate asks how the actual represented beings and esse respect are to be identified.
